artworks.title: The Garden Draws Them Near
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a completed full-bleed square fine-art work to exhibit in a 3D vocabulary museum. Create at native high resolution, at least 1024 by 1024 (prefer 1536 by 1536), square. Rich artistic craft and detail, coherent complete scene with a legible subject; compelling across a room and interesting close up. No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks, logos, picture frames, borders, isolated sticker cutouts, white sticker outlines, labels, captions, or infographic poster layout.
Style: sophisticated expressive impressionist oil painting with lively broken brushwork, tactile impasto accents, nuanced painterly depth and studied natural light. Cohesive palette of emerald, ochre, terracotta, warm ivory and blue-green shadows. A beautiful autonomous museum painting with emotional atmosphere, never a stock illustration.
Illustrate attract: to cause someone or something to come, become interested or take part. A luxuriant late-summer garden of flowering herbs and crimson dahlias draws a small gathering of honeybees. In the foreground a richly painted open flower and a clearly visible bee approaching it; other tiny bees drift naturally toward the flower bed farther back. Entire immersive garden scene, luminous leaves, earthen terracotta pots half-concealed among stems, warm late afternoon light, a distant emerald garden wall. Subtle curved stems draw the eye toward the irresistible blossoms. Accurate bee proportions, wings and legs, no giant fantastical insects. No people needed. Painterly rather than photographic.
